name: Vacuum Tool

toolSizeX.label: Tool size X (m)
toolSizeX.desc: Length of the vacuum plate. The orange dots on the tool itself drag this in the viewport, and they ride the arm, so you can size the tool in whatever pose you are inspecting. Size it to the product you are picking - the plate is also the grab reach.

toolSizeZ.label: Tool size Z (m)
toolSizeZ.desc: Width of the vacuum plate, dragged by the same orange dots on the tool.

cupPitchX.label: Cup pitch X (m)
cupPitchX.desc: Centre-to-centre spacing of the suction cups along the plate length. The plate fits as many as the pitch allows, so tightening it adds cups rather than moving them.

cupPitchZ.label: Cup pitch Z (m)
cupPitchZ.desc: Centre-to-centre spacing of the suction cups across the plate width.

cupMarginX.label: Cup margin X (m)
cupMarginX.desc: Inset from each end of the plate before the first cup, so the grid does not run off the edge.

cupMarginZ.label: Cup margin Z (m)
cupMarginZ.desc: Inset from each side of the plate before the first cup.

cupsEnabled.label: Suction cups
cupsEnabled.desc: Draw the cup grid under the plate. Appearance only - the grip itself comes from the robot's vacuum, not from the cups being visible.
